name: uniagents
description: Pools the Claude accounts already on your machine into one continuous session. No login, no stored state.
//: ZERO runtime dependencies, deliberately. This process reads your auth tokens and proxies them upstream; an empty supply chain is a security property worth more than a nicer HTTP client API. node:https with keepAlive gives us connection pooling, and its headers-before-body event model is a better fit for the no-retry-after-commit rule than any promise-based client. TypeScript is dev-only and never ships.
